 Immortal OTT release date confirmed: When and where to watch GV Prakash, Kayadu Lohar’s Tamil romantic horror movie online
 SECTIONS Immortal OTT release date confirmed: When and where to watch GV Prakash, Kayadu Lohar’s Tamil romantic horror movie online By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 24, 2026, 12:13:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Immortal is an intriguing Tamil romantic horror film starring GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar. The storyline is a mix of heartwarming romance with eerie supernatural twists, revolving around a young man's fateful meeting with a mysterious woman. Read on to know when and where to watch the movie online.
 Streaming details of Immortal (Credit: Instagram) GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar ’s Tamil romantic horror film Immortal combines a love story with supernatural mystery. The film follows a young man whose search for affordable accommodation leads him to a woman hiding a dangerous secret. The movie was released in theatres on September 4, 2026 and now its gearing up for the digital release.
 Immortal OTT release date details
Immortal will premiere on SonyLIV on October 30, 2026. The streaming platform confirmed the digital release through its official social media account, giving viewers a chance to watch the Tamil film online after its theatrical run.
Announcing the premiere, SonyLIV used the tagline “Oru pudhu ulagam... Oru IMMORTAL kadhal!”, which translates to “A new world… an immortal love story.” The line hints at the film’s mix of romance and supernatural elements.
Written and directed by Mariappan Chinna, Immortal features GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar in the lead roles. The supporting cast includes TM Karthik, Kumar Natarajan, Lollu Sabha Maaran, Aaditya Kathir, Arshu Maharjan and Pema Tsamchoe.
 You Might Also Like: Anirudh Ravichander-Kavya Maran wedding guest list: PM Modi to Sonia Gandhi to Tamil Nadu CM Vijay, who all are invited?
 The film is produced by Arunkumar Dhanasekaran under the AK Film Factory banner. Sam CS has composed the music, while Arun Radhakrishnan is the cinematographer. M. Rajesh has handled the editing.
 What is Immortal about? Plot and trailer details
The story begins around 1,000 years ago, when a tribal couple gives birth to a mysterious child. The child’s supernatural nature sets the stage for an ancient evil that continues to affect events centuries later.
 The story then shifts to present-day Chennai where Magi (GV Prakash Kumar) works in a printing press. When he happens to come across a swanky apartment, he is on the lookout for a place he can afford. Sindhu (Kayadu Lohar) offers him a place to stay for unbelievably cheap rent.
With limited options, Magi accepts her offer. As he settles into the apartment, he grows closer to Sindhu and gradually falls for her. However, her unusual behaviour and the strange incidents around him leave him wondering whether she is hiding something.
 You Might Also Like: Jailer 2 box office collection day 9: Rajinikanth's film becomes second highest-grossing Tamil film ever. Earns Rs 628 crore worldwide
Finally he discovers the true nature of Sindhu and his doubts are confirmed. She is a supernatural creature connected to the ancient evil introduced at the beginning of the film. Taking on a human appearance, she lures men into her world and feeds on them.
 Immortal cast and crew: Who stars in the Tamil film?
GV Prakash Kumar leads the film as Magi, while Kayadu Lohar plays Sindhu, the mysterious woman whose identity drives the story. Their characters form the centre of the film’s romantic and supernatural conflict.
The ensemble also features TM Karthik, Kumar Natarajan, Lollu Sabha Maaran, Aaditya Kathir, Arshu Maharjan and Pema Tsamchoe in supporting roles.
Mariappan Chinna has written and directed the film. Producer Arunkumar Dhanasekaran has backed the project under AK Film Factory. Sam CS, known for his work as a film composer, has created the soundtrack, with Arun Radhakrishnan handling cinematography and M. Rajesh overseeing editing.
After its theatrical release in September, Immortal is now set to reach a wider audience through streaming. Viewers interested in Tamil horror films with a romantic storyline can watch GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar’s film on SonyLIV from October 30, 2026.
